traceability.evidence: Story file exists and matches assessed spec: docs/stories/021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX.story.md (read_file).,Rule implementation: src/rules/require-test-traceability.ts defines options autoFixTestTemplate, autoFixTestPrefixFormat, and testSupportsTemplate in the TestTraceabilityOptions type and JSON schema, and sets meta.fixable: "code". It wires auto-fix behavior through ensureFileSupportsAnnotation and handleCallExpression:, - In create(context): - determineIsTestFile(...) used to gate behavior to test files. - ensureFileSupportsAnnotation(context, sourceCode, { autoFixTestTemplate, testSupportsTemplate }) is always called for test files. - CallExpression visitor is created via handleCallExpression(context, { sourceCode, describeRegex, requireDescribeStory, requireTestReqPrefix, autoFixTestPrefixFormat }). - File-level JSDoc includes @supports docs/stories/021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX.story.md REQ-TEST-FIX-TEMPLATE REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE REQ-TEST-FIX-PLACEHOLDER REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE, explicitly linking this rule to the story requirements.,Helper implementation (file-level template + safe test name fixes): src/rules/helpers/require-test-traceability-helpers.ts, - REQ-TEST-FIX-TEMPLATE / REQ-TEST-FIX-PLACEHOLDER: - buildSupportsTemplateComment(customTemplate?: string) builds a placeholder @supports comment: - Default baseTemplate: "@supports docs/stories/XXX.X-STORY-NAME.story.md REQ-XXX-YYY REQ-XXX-ZZZ". - Adds TODO line: "* TODO: Replace the placeholder story path and REQ-IDs with real values for this test file.". - Returns a full JSDoc block with opening "/**", per-line " * ...", closing " */" and a trailing blank line, matching the story’s example and providing clear placeholders. - insertSupportsTemplate(fixer, sourceCode, customTemplate?) (tagged with REQ-TEST-FIX-TEMPLATE, REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE, REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE) inserts the template at a safe location: - Detects and preserves shebang lines by inserting after the first newline when text starts with "#!". - Otherwise inserts at file start. - Uses fixer.insertTextBeforeRange([insertIndex, insertIndex], templateComment) so only a comment is added and code semantics are unchanged. - ensureFileSupportsAnnotation(context, sourceCode, autoFixOptions) (tagged with story 020.0 and 021.0) implements the file-level template behavior: - Scans sourceCode.getAllComments() for any @supports tag. - If none found, reports messageId: "missingFileSupports" on a safe node. - Attaches a fix only when autoFixOptions.autoFixTestTemplate !== false, using insertSupportsTemplate with optional autoFixOptions.testSupportsTemplate. - This satisfies: automatic file-level template insertion, safe-only fixing, no inference of real story paths/REQ IDs, and preservation of existing code., - REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT / REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE / REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE / REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE: - normalizeReqId(raw: string) (tagged with REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT and REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE) performs purely local formatting on IDs that already start with "REQ" (case-insensitive): - Uppercases, strips leading separators after "REQ", converts whitespace/underscores to hyphens, collapses multiple hyphens. - Returns existing ID in canonical form, never creates a brand-new semantic identifier. - normalizeReqPrefixInDescription(description: string): string | null (tagged with REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT, REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE, REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE) normalizes malformed prefixes only when a REQ ID is already present at the start: - If string already matches canonical /^\[REQ-[^\]]+]/, returns null (no change). - Handles square-bracket forms with extra spaces: "[ REQ-XXX ]..." → "[REQ-XXX]...". - Handles underscore forms: "[REQ_XXX]..." → "[REQ-XXX]...". - Handles parenthesis forms: "(REQ-XXX)..." → "[REQ-XXX]...". - Converts lowercased IDs like "[req-xxx]" to "[REQ-XXX]" (via normalizeReqId). - Returns null if no leading REQ prefix is found, ensuring no auto-fix when there is no identifiable requirement ID. - createUpdatedStringLiteralRaw(originalNode, newValue, sourceCode) (tagged with REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE) preserves the original quote style and escaping when updating the literal, ensuring formatting and surrounding code are preserved. - handleItOrTestCall(context, node, description, options) uses the above helpers: - Only runs when requireTestReqPrefix is true. - If description does not already start with canonical [REQ-...]: - Computes normalizedDescription via normalizeReqPrefixInDescription(description) when autoFixTestPrefixFormat !== false. - Always reports messageId: "missingReqPrefix". - Only attaches a fixer when ALL of the following are true: autoFixTestPrefixFormat !== false, normalizedDescription !== null, first argument is a string Literal. The fixer replaces only the literal node text using createUpdatedStringLiteralRaw. - If there is no REQ prefix at all (normalizeReqPrefixInDescription returns null), the rule reports an error but does not auto-fix, matching REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE and REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE. - handleCallExpression(...) traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for story 021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX are fully implemented and verified. The require-test-traceability rule and its helpers provide:
- Automatic insertion of a file-level @supports template with clear TODO placeholders when missing, controlled by the autoFixTestTemplate and testSupportsTemplate options. - Safe normalization of malformed [REQ-XXX] prefixes in test names (spacing, underscores, parentheses, and casing) via autoFixTestPrefixFormat, only when a recognizable REQ ID already exists. - Strict non-inference of real story paths or requirement IDs (missing-prefix cases are reported but not fixed, and the file-level template uses static placeholders). - Preservation of test behavior and formatting by touching only comments and string literal values while preserving quote style and escaping. - Comprehensive tests in tests/rules/require-test-traceability.test.ts covering all specified requirements (REQ-TEST-FIX-TEMPLATE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT, REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PLACEHOLDER, REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE), all of which pass in the current Jest run. - User-facing documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md that explicitly describes the Story 021.0 auto-fix capabilities and configuration options, aligning with the story’s Documentation and Template Quality criteria.
Given the concrete implementation, passing tests, and up-to-date documentation, this story is assessed as PASSED.
